items.title: Henry "Sleepy" Robertson Interview, 1961-09-22
items.q: We had a fella out of that in there called Black Eagle. He was playing trumpet too over there with us.

ctx.x: The little fella, he used to jump up and down when he played.

No, it wasn't Chester. I know this other day. Chester. No, it wasn't him. No, this fella here. He belonged in Manderville too. Well, we had a fella. We had a fella out of that in there called Black Eagle. Black Eagle. He was playing trumpet too over there with us. Black Eagle. Yeah. Any time a man played his way out of penitentiary, you know he could play.

items.title: Henry "Sleepy" Robertson Interview, 1961-09-22
items.q: Furan got in trouble over there and used to set up on the wall that damn play trumpet. Used to allow him to blow that trumpet and let him make a little band up in there.

ctx.x: Yeah, boy, Furan got in trouble over there and used to set up on the wall that damn play trumpet. Used to allow him to blow that trumpet and let him make a little band up in there. Oh yeah. So, them people got him out of there. Yeah. Black Eagle. Little, little, little, little, little, little, little, little, little black black. Probably he could know. You never knew his name or any other name.
